title: Phase 3d Energy Scoring Schema
description: Physics-based energy scores from Rosetta/FoldX for final design evaluation

ddg_bind.description: Change in binding energy (kcal/mol), more negative = stronger binding

ddg_fold.description: Change in folding stability (kcal/mol), < 1 kcal/mol is good

shape_complementarity.description: Interface shape complementarity score (>0.55 is good)

buried_sasa.description: Total buried surface area including side chains (Ų)

hbond_count.description: Number of hydrogen bonds at interface

salt_bridge_count.description: Number of salt bridges at interface

rosetta_score.description: Overall Rosetta energy score (REU units, lower is better)

correlates_with_ai_metrics.description: Energy scores correlate positively with AI confidence metrics

viral_parameter_compatible.description: Maintains compatibility with all 5 viral parameters

notes.description: Additional notes on design quality and feasibility
